course_name: 數值分析在結構工程上之應用
outline: This course introduces students to the formulation, methodology, and techniques for numerical solution of engineering problems. Topics covered include the solution of systems of linear equations, including direct and iterative techniques, roots of equations and systems of equations, numerical interpolation, differentiation and integration, fundamentals of finite-difference solutions to ordinary differential equations, and error and convergence analysis.
schedule:
Major Topics
(1) Solutions of nonlinear equations
(2) Solving sets of equations
(3) Curve fitting (least square method)
(4) Interpolating polynomials
(5) Numerical Differentiation and numerical Integration
(6) Numerical solution of Ordinary differential equation
(7) Finite difference method
assessment:
平時作業：40%，期中考30%，期末考30%
( 曠課三次(含)以上，以零分計算 )
